NhenI am gone,release me,let me go
You have so many things to see and do
ou mustn't tie yourself to me with tears
8e happy that we had these years
gave you my love.You can only gues.
How much you gave me in happiness
thank you for the love you each haye shown
But now it's time [ traveled on alone
o grieve a while tor me,if grieve you must
Ihen letyour griet be comfortedby trust
t's only tor a while that we must part
obless the memories within your heart
won't be far away for life goes on
o it you need me,call and I will hear
Ihough you can't see or touch me,I'll be near..

All of my love around you soft and clear
